selection: smallest individuals_per_cell passing all thresholds in every frozen robustness scenario after all required candidate N values have been evaluated

interpretation.fit_success: At least 95% of simulations must produce a usable frozen-model fit in every required robustness scenario.
interpretation.h1: At least 80% directional two-sided rejection for the frozen H1 SESOI in every required robustness scenario.
interpretation.h2: At least 80% hierarchical H2 pass, including H1 gatekeeping, in every required robustness scenario.
interpretation.monte_carlo: At least 1000 simulations per scenario; the same simulation count must be used across all candidate N and robustness scenarios.
interpretation.scenario_count: All 3 baseline x 4 nuisance robustness profiles must be present at every candidate N.
interpretation.candidate_n: No smaller counterbalanced N may be omitted from the operating-characteristic surface; the sequence is 4, 8, 12, ... through the frozen operational maximum.

firewalls: thresholds cannot be changed after the final operating-characteristic surface is visible
a failing robustness scenario cannot be averaged away
the smallest passing counterbalanced N must be selected mechanically
H1/H2 SESOI values remain frozen separately in validation/routeability_sesoi_gate_v1.json
candidate N values cannot start above 4 or contain gaps
claim_ceiling: This rule fixes operating-characteristic thresholds and gapless candidate-N coverage. It does not determine the nuisance/baseline robustness grid, the husbandry-defined operational maximum, or the final N before real pilot inputs exist.
candidate_n_coverage: every multiple of four from 4 through the separately frozen operational maximum individuals_per_cell
